prompt: In the Splice project {project} (a 10-second screen recording), add an animated counter that counts up from 0 to 1,000 users over the first 3 seconds, a thin progress bar along the bottom that fills over the whole video, and a confetti burst at 3 seconds. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: a counter to 1000
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'title' and any(e['type'] == 'counter' for e in i.get('effects', [])) for i in items)

checks.name: a progress bar
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'shape' and any(e['type'] == 'progress' for e in i.get('effects', [])) for i in items)

checks.name: confetti
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'shape' and any(e['type'] == 'particles' for e in i.get('effects', [])) for i in items)
